name: Grenzo
description: Goblin dungeon keeper who released Selvala to kill Muzzio.

description_citations.text: "Selvala of Alberon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Grenzo secures a post as Dungeon Keeper of Brago.
timeline.quote: the goblin Grenzo managed to secure himself a position as Dungeon Keeper of Brago

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Fiora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ervos walks Marchesa through why a direct attack or poisoning would fail, noting her zombie guards, escape routes and food precautions.
timeline.quote: So, killing you through your food would be out of the question.

citation.text: "The Black Rose" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Selvala sits in isolation in a dungeon cell among insects, hearing the dungeon keeper taunt her; she had earlier dealt with goblins who came to her door.
timeline.quote: She'd dealt with each of them in turn.

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Selvala tells Grenzo she is armed with a sharpened femur; he reveals she took the eye of one of his best agents with it.
timeline.quote: Selvala smiled and fingered the crudely sharpened weapon at her side.

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grenzo asks what it is like to kill a man you love, and Selvala answers that it is all too easy; he unlocks the cell door.
timeline.quote: Selvala said, "All too easy."

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grenzo leads Selvala through the tunnels under Paliano, pointing out the palace, Brago's bedchamber, Sydri's shop and the treasury.
timeline.quote: Slowly, the map of Paliano began to make sense to her

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grenzo offers Selvala gold, access, information or the chance to kill an enemy.
timeline.quote: "What about the opportunity to kill an enemy for a change?"

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grenzo opens a secret door and Selvala enters Muzzio's library full of clockwork automata.
timeline.quote: All around Selvala, ornate automata clanked and whirred.

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grenzo describes Muzzio, student of Daretti, who promises a perfectly crafted, programmed world to replace the living.
timeline.quote: He promised us a new world.

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grenzo asks Selvala to kill the sleeping Muzzio, saying a king with no blood and beasts of iron flesh are the future unless she acts.
timeline.quote: Through that door, Muzzio lies sleeping.

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Selvala refuses, kicks away Grenzo's staff and threatens his throat.
timeline.quote: I will not be your hired thug.

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grenzo escapes down the secret stairs and locks the trap door; Selvala breaks the lock with her bone and flees.
timeline.quote: Then, with a snap, the bone cracked in half and the lock gave way.

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: A mob of goblins pelts the sentry with vegetables and a firebomb to draw him from his post.
timeline.quote: Weapon raised, he raced for them.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Grenzo smashes in the villa door with his staff, grumbling that Marchesa locked him out of his dungeons.
timeline.quote: One sharp thump from his staff and the villa door crashed to the ground.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Grenzo's goblins flood into the villa's foyer and start looting.
timeline.quote: The crowd of goblins flooded into the foyer

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Goblins have overpowered and tied up three city guards beneath a toppled bookshelf.
timeline.quote: Three city guards lay unconscious on the floor, pinned under a toppled bookshelf.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Grenzo smashes Fimarell's desk and says the papers of praise are fuel.
timeline.quote: This is fuel.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Daretti finds blueprints for one of the first cogwork sentries bearing the Academy seal.
timeline.quote: It's the blueprints for a cogwork sentry.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Grenzo tells Daretti the Academy is dead, Muzzio exiled and cogwork outlawed, and urges him to act like a hyena.
timeline.quote: Well, the academy is dead and Muzzio is exiled.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Daretti, stirred, tells Grenzo to burn everything.
timeline.quote: Burn it. Burn it all. Burn the ashes.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Daretti finds yellowed parchment among the papers that tells him it is time for fresher prey.
timeline.quote: He withdrew some yellowed parchment.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: At the top of the stairs Daretti forgets his speech and Grenzo prompts him through it.
timeline.quote: I've forgotten it.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Fimarell spots the goblins in the hallway, yells thieves and slams his bedroom door.
timeline.quote: "Thieves!" Fimarell yelled and slammed the door.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Grenzo burns the manuscript in a pot and drops burning refuse onto the street.
timeline.quote: Grenzo dropped the torch after them.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Grenzo's minions smash the furniture, pile it with papers and pour oil on it.
timeline.quote: One poured oil over the pile.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Grenzo and Daretti bicker over who is whose protege while the fire takes hold of the villa.
timeline.quote: The flames caught quickly and the fire crackled, crawling up the walls.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Daretti names Alendis, who apparently joined the Custodi, as his next target; Grenzo adds anyone in league with Marchesa.
timeline.quote: Sounds like the oily bastard joined the Custodi.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Grenzo muses that Marchesa once ran in shadows but now locks every door, and proposes crashing all their parties.
timeline.quote: Now she's got her comfy chair and locks every door at night.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Grenzo infiltrates Adriana's gatherings and turns peaceful demonstrations into violent mobs.
timeline.quote: He has twice now taken advantage of large gatherings assembled by Captain Adriana

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana stages prison breaks to bring her former guards back to her side while Grenzo abdicates his post.
timeline.quote: Adriana has managed to stage some rather daring rescues to bring her former guards to her side

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: After Marchesa is crowned, Daretti allies with disenfranchised goblins under Grenzo to take revenge, and his schemes lead to the Academy's disbanding.
timeline.quote: His schemes were responsible for the disbanding of the Academy

citation.text: "Daretti", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Daretti and Grenzo raid Professor Fimarell's home; Daretti discovers the plagiarism and kills Fimarell.
timeline.quote: After killing Fimarell, he and the other goblins turned their attention to the former academy members

citation.text: "Daretti", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Grenzo releases Selvala to kill Muzzio; she frees the constructs in his tunnels and leaves the High City.
timeline.quote: Selvala left the High City and went back to the wild places far below and far beyond.

citation.text: "Selvala of Alberon", section "Release". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: She refuses to serve him and threatens him.
relations.quote: I will not be your hired thug.

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: His agents work for the dungeon keeper.
relations.quote: about his agents swarming in the sewers

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: They work together and bicker over who leads.
relations.quote: Let's be clear here. You are my enforcer.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

relations.note: allied with goblins under Grenzo's leadership
relations.quote: Daretti allied with several disenfranchised goblins under the leadership of Grenzo

citation.text: "Daretti", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A figure with whom Marchesa has arrangements, said by Ervos to guard the sewers.

citation.text: "The Black Rose" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 May 2014.

pages_say.description: A hunched goblin dungeon keeper who commands a network of spies and killers beneath Paliano and knows its secret passages.

citation.text: "Blood Will Have Blood". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jun 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: A dungeon warden who speaks of the price of revolution.

citation.text: Conspiracy: card flavor text (Conspiracy, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A hunched, hulking goblin with a staff who leads goblin lackeys, breaks into Fimarell's villa and burns it, and is locked out of his dungeons by Marchesa.

citation.text: "Bloody Instructions" by Shawn Main and Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Aug 2016.

pages_say.description: A goblin who was warden of Brago's prisons and now incites mobs and anarchy against the idea of the city.

citation.text: "Leovold's Dossiers" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2016.

pages_say.description: A goblin and former dungeon warden of the palace prison who led disenfranchised goblins with Daretti.

citation.text: "Daretti". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A goblin of Fiora who became Dungeon Keeper of Brago.

citation.text: "Goblin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Goblin dungeon keeper who released Selvala to kill Muzzio.

citation.text: "Selvala of Alberon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
